# GlobeCareer — International Career Platform

> [GlobeCareer](https://globecareer.online) is a 100% free international CV and resume builder, career document suite, and global job search platform. It features country-specific CV formatting across 47 jurisdictions, ATS optimization, and zero paywalls or subscriptions.

## Core Free Capabilities

- [International Resume Builder](https://globecareer.online/resume-builder): Interactive CV creator with real-time ATS keyword matching, photo and no-photo compliance for 47 countries, and free vector PDF and DOCX export.
- [ATS Resume Maker](https://globecareer.online/ats-resume-maker): Guided ATS-first resume workflow that starts from a country and industry preset.
- [Resume & CV Templates](https://globecareer.online/templates): Country-tailored single-column ATS layouts and European photo CV formats, downloadable as Microsoft Word (.docx) or PDF.
- [Cover Letter Builder](https://globecareer.online/cover-letter-builder): Tailored cover letters with country-specific norms and export.
- [Cover Letter & Letter Templates](https://globecareer.online/letter-templates): Curated cover letter, recommendation letter, and outreach templates.
- [ATS Resume Checker](https://globecareer.online/ats-checker): Real-time resume versus job description match score, missing skills analysis, and formatting audits.
- [Job Application Email Generator](https://globecareer.online/email-generator): Formal application emails, cold outreach messages, and follow-ups.
- [Recommendation Letter Builder](https://globecareer.online/recommendation-letter): Academic, employment, and graduate reference letters.
- [Recommendation Letter Guide](https://globecareer.online/recommendation-letter-guide): Step-by-step guidance on requesting and structuring reference letters.
- [Interview Preparation](https://globecareer.online/interview-prep): STAR method frameworks, mock practice questions, and international hiring etiquette.
- [Professional Bio Generator](https://globecareer.online/bio-generator): Industry templates with Short, Medium, and Extended outputs.
- [Bio Templates](https://globecareer.online/bio-templates): First-person and third-person professional bio examples.
- [Resume Summary & Objective Generator](https://globecareer.online/summary-generator): ATS-tested professional summaries and LinkedIn headlines.
- [Resume Summary Templates](https://globecareer.online/summary-templates): Copy-ready resume summaries and career objectives by industry.
- [Resume Objective Generator](https://globecareer.online/resume-objective-generator): Career objective and objective statement examples.
- [Resignation Letter Generator](https://globecareer.online/resignation-letter): Departure scenarios with global notice rules for US, UK, Germany, and Australia.
- [Resignation Letter Templates](https://globecareer.online/resignation-letter-templates): Two weeks notice, short notice, and relocation letters.
- [Resume Word Counter](https://globecareer.online/resume-word-counter): Word count, readability, and one-page versus two-page fit analysis.
- [Resume Bullet Point Generator](https://globecareer.online/resume-bullet-generator): Action-verb achievement statements tailored for applicant tracking systems.
- [Resume Phrase Generator](https://globecareer.online/resume-phrase-generator): Professional phrasing for experience and skills sections.
- [Verified Jobs Portal](https://globecareer.online/jobs): Authenticated international and remote positions with verified employer links and anti-scam safeguards.
- [Job Application Tracker](https://globecareer.online/job-tracker): Free Kanban pipeline for tracking wishlists, applied roles, interviews, offers, and follow-up deadlines.
- [Online Resume Map](https://globecareer.online/resume-map): Interactive comparison of global CV standards.

## Editorial Guides

- [47 Country CV Hiring Guides](https://globecareer.online/country-guides): Specific rules on photos, paper sizes (Letter vs. A4), document length, and data privacy for 47 nations.
- [Resume Writing Guide](https://globecareer.online/resume-writing-guide): How long a resume should be by country, the XYZ achievement formula, how to list certifications and volunteer work.
- [ATS Optimization Handbook](https://globecareer.online/ats-guide): How applicant tracking systems parse resumes and which formatting breaks them.
- [European CV Format](https://globecareer.online/european-cv-format): ISO A4 dimensions, CEFR language levels, and EU photo conventions.
- [CV vs Resume](https://globecareer.online/cv-vs-resume): Length, terminology, and photo differences between US resumes and UK/EU CVs.
- [Top Resume Skills](https://globecareer.online/resume-skills): Hard, soft, and technical skills by industry.
- [Reverse Chronological Resume Format](https://globecareer.online/reverse-chronological-resume-format): The standard work-history layout.
- [References on a Resume](https://globecareer.online/references-on-resume): Why references stay off the resume and how to format a reference sheet.
- [Resume Examples by Role](https://globecareer.online/resume-examples): Industry achievement bullets, ATS keyword banks, and guidance for applying abroad.
- [Customer Service Resume Guide](https://globecareer.online/resume-examples/customer-service): Responsibilities, CRM fluency, escalation handling and screening keywords for support roles.
- [Software Engineer Resume Guide](https://globecareer.online/resume-examples/software-engineer): Systems, testing and reliability evidence by engineering level.
- [Registered Nurse Resume Guide](https://globecareer.online/resume-examples/registered-nurse): Licence-first structure, clinical responsibilities and safe ways to quantify caseload.
- [Teacher Resume Guide](https://globecareer.online/resume-examples/teacher): Curriculum, phase and safeguarding evidence for school applications.
- [Data Analyst Resume Guide](https://globecareer.online/resume-examples/data-analyst): SQL depth, dashboard ownership and decision-level impact.
- [Project Manager Resume Guide](https://globecareer.online/resume-examples/project-manager): Scope, budget and recovery stories by seniority.
- [Marketing Manager Resume Guide](https://globecareer.online/resume-examples/marketing-manager): Channel ownership, budget management and honest attribution.
- [Sales Representative Resume Guide](https://globecareer.online/resume-examples/sales-representative): Quota attainment, deal shape and CRM evidence.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://globecareer.online/faq): Resume formats, ATS compliance, photo rules, and international employment.

## Platform Standards

- **100% Free:** No credit cards, no subscriptions, no watermarks, no gated downloads.
- **Privacy First:** Client-side local storage draft persistence.
- **Canonical Domain:** [GlobeCareer Official Site](https://globecareer.online)
- **Sitemap:** [XML Sitemap](https://globecareer.online/sitemap.xml)
